event.name: Moffat County Hot Air Balloon Festival

profile.description: Established Adventure Zone history: Adventure Zone attended this festival in prior years and the organizer specifically invited a 2027 discussion after the 2026 festival.

notes.subject: Explicit 2027 invitation after prior Adventure Zone attendance
notes.body: Gmail history shows Adventure Zone attended the Moffat County Balloon Festival from 2015-2019. In February 2026 Randy Looper discussed the prior pay-for-play arrangement, and on Feb. 20 he said they would talk about getting Adventure Zone on the 2027 schedule after the 2026 festival. This should be treated as a warm renewal opportunity.
